name: Rökvale
summary:
Your heroes keep fighting while you live your life. Rökvale is a medieval pixel-art idle MMORPG: deep, old-school character builds, a living town full of real players, your own house and farm — and progress that keeps going while you're away.

Build a party, send it to hunt, and come back to loot, EXP and new decisions to make. When you want to play actively, walk around town, trade at the market, climb the Tower with friends or decorate your home.
